settings.label: Doors swing away from you
settings.description: A door could swing into you depending on your side; now it always opens away.

settings.label: Overlapping areas all apply
settings.description: Indoors by a fire, at a heated workbench: the game only counted the last area it checked.

settings.label: Fair event odds
settings.description: Event chances are what they say. The game picks one event and rolls only that, so a 15% event happened under 4% of the time.

settings.label: Visits without an event (at least, %)
settings.description: If the events' chances add up to more than the rest, they're scaled down.

settings.label: AI sight on foggy nights
settings.description: AI see 40 m at night and 100 m in fog; on foggy nights the game used 100 m.

settings.label: No furniture lost to a full catalog
settings.description: Picking furniture up with a full catalog deleted it, with anything stored inside.

settings.label: Put furniture back if it can't go there
settings.description: Moving furniture with nowhere valid to place it left you stuck holding it.

settings.label: Steady tooltips
settings.description: Tooltips closed on the tiniest mouse move.

settings.label: Right trader tax on arrival
settings.description: Just after loading a map, a trader could show full tax and no tasks done until you came back.

settings.label: Floor loot spawns properly
settings.description: Some floor loot never appeared, and some appeared several times over.

settings.label: Unstuck key
settings.description: Stuck in the scenery? Hold the key for 2 seconds to go back to where you stood a few seconds ago.

settings.label: No shadows around traders (performance)
settings.description: For frame drops when looking toward a trader.
